wish_res = apis.amazon.show_wish_list(access_token=amazon_token)
print(wish_res)
wish_items = wish_res or []
print('wish_count', len(wish_items))
wish_qty_by_id = {it['product_id']: it.get('quantity') for it in wish_items}
print('wish_product_ids', sorted(wish_qty_by_id.keys()))

under_42_pids = [pid for pid,r in product_ratings.items() if r < 4.2]
print('moving_pids', under_42_pids)
move_results = []
for pid in under_42_pids:
    qty = cart_items_by_id[pid]['quantity']
    res = apis.amazon.move_product_from_cart_to_wish_list(product_id=pid, access_token=amazon_token, quantity=qty)
    print('moved', pid, 'qty', qty, 'res', res)
    move_results.append({'product_id': pid, 'quantity': qty, 'result': res})
print('move_count', len(move_results))

post_cart = apis.amazon.show_cart(access_token=amazon_token)
post_wish = apis.amazon.show_wish_list(access_token=amazon_token)
post_cart_items = post_cart.get('cart_items', [])
post_cart_qty_by_id = {it['product_id']: it.get('quantity') for it in post_cart_items}
post_cart_ids = sorted(post_cart_qty_by_id.keys())
post_wish_items = post_wish or []
post_wish_qty_by_id = {it['product_id']: it.get('quantity') for it in post_wish_items}
post_wish_ids = sorted(post_wish_qty_by_id.keys())
print('POST_CART_IDS', post_cart_ids)
print('POST_WISH_IDS', post_wish_ids)
print('POST_CART_QTY', post_cart_qty_by_id)
print('POST_WISH_QTY', post_wish_qty_by_id)
under_42_pids=set([pid for pid,r in product_ratings.items() if r<4.2])
remaining_ids_under_42 = under_42_pids.intersection(set(post_cart_qty_by_id.keys()))
print('remaining_under_42_in_cart_count', len(remaining_ids_under_42), 'ids', sorted(remaining_ids_under_42))
expected_wish_quantities={pid: cart_items_by_id[pid]['quantity'] for pid in under_42_pids}
print('expected_wish_qty', expected_wish_quantities)
missing_in_wish = under_42_pids - set(post_wish_qty_by_id.keys())
print('missing_in_wish', missing_in_wish)
qty_mismatches={pid:(post_wish_qty_by_id.get(pid), expected_wish_quantities[pid]) for pid in under_42_pids if post_wish_qty_by_id.get(pid)!=expected_wish_quantities[pid]}
print('qty_mismatches', qty_mismatches)
